name: write-notes-like-deepseek
description: 像 DeepSeek 团队一样维护项目：把他们在 DeepSeek Harness 里用的那套方法，装进你的仓库

scripts.verify-notes: npx tsx skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts && npx tsx skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts && npx tsx skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts
scripts.init-board: npx tsx skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/build-board.ts --init board.html '工程决策看板'
scripts.bundle-board: npx tsx skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/build-board.ts --bundle .agents/notes demo.html '工程决策看板'
scripts.build-board: npx tsx skills/write-notes-like-deepseek/scripts/build-board.ts --init board.html '工程决策看板'
